headline: OpenAI Nears Up to $30 Billion Funding Round at $1.25 Trillion Valuation, Led by UAE Investors and Coatue
raw_snippet: OpenAI is finalizing a $30 billion-plus private bridge round at a revised $1.25 trillion valuation, down from an earlier $1.4 trillion target. The round is led by UAE investors and Coatue, with commitments due by October 30. Even at the trimmed price, the valuation is about 50% above OpenAI's last round in March at approximately $852 billion.

headline: OpenAI Trims Pre-IPO Valuation Target to $1.25 Trillion After Pitching Higher Price
raw_snippet: OpenAI trimmed its valuation target to $1.25 trillion from approximately $1.4 trillion after demand from wealthy private clients came in softer than pitched. The round serves as a bridge to OpenAI's IPO, now expected in the first half of 2027. Alongside the round, big compute negotiations in the UAE are under way.

headline: OpenAI Buys Drug Development Company Orchestra Bio
raw_snippet: OpenAI acquired Orchestra Bio, a drug development company, marking an expansion beyond core AI products into healthcare and biotech. The acquisition signals OpenAI's interest in applying its AI capabilities to pharmaceutical research and drug discovery.

headline: Three OpenAI Safety Researchers Fired Over Leak Suspicions After Phone Search
raw_snippet: Three OpenAI safety researchers were summoned to meetings with the company's security team last month and asked to unlock their personal phones. The company suspected them of leaking internal AI model designs. All three were fired a week later. OpenAI says they violated company policy; the researchers dispute that account in interviews with the WSJ.

headline: AI Safety Advocates Call on OpenAI and Anthropic to Cap Compute Used for R&D
raw_snippet: AI safety advocates are proposing that AI labs including OpenAI and Anthropic cap the amount of compute used for R&D to ensure safeguards keep pace with technology advances. Last week, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman laid out three scenarios for how AI development could be paced. Ideas are flowing fast on how to balance rapid AI capability growth with safety requirements.

headline: SB Energy Delays IPO for OpenAI Data Center in Ohio to December or Later
raw_snippet: SoftBank's SB Energy, which is building an OpenAI data center in Ohio, bounced back from potentially canceling its IPO and is now looking at December or later for its public offering. The delay reflects broader market headwinds for AI infrastructure companies.
